title: Email (Outlook-style)
description: A single email as seen in a desktop mail client reading pane (screen variant) or as printed from it (print variant). Write the body as the sender would: greeting, short paragraphs, sign-off.

senderInitials.description: Letters for the sender's avatar disc when the display name is not a plain first and last name

to.description: Recipients as displayed (names or addresses, separated by semicolons)

sentAt.description: Sent date-time as the client shows it

body.description: Message body as plain text. Blank lines separate paragraphs.
examples:
Ops,

We have a major issue.

— BHS Duty Manager

signature.description: Signature block under the body (newlines kept)
examples:
BHS Duty Manager
Baggage Handling Systems | x2210

attachments.description: Attachment chips shown above the body

name.description: File name with extension (extension picks the icon)

importance.description: Message importance (high shows the red exclamation and info bar)

external.description: Show the external-sender caution banner (mail from outside the organization)

printedBy.description: Mailbox owner printed at the top of the print variant
